365:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

365:t_1:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...So $$オルソン$$ is on $$翠の地球$$.」

365:t_1:5.en:
$$桂$$
「According to $$クィーン$$, it seems so.」

365:t_1:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Who's this $$オルソン$$ guy?」

365:t_1:7.en:
$$桂$$
「He's my longtime partner. And, while we're at it, the other half of the $$特異点$$ pair.」

365:t_1:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Mathematically, it refers to an object excluded from a definition, but in the multiverse, it refers to a base point of distortion or intersection in spacetime, or a knot.」

365:t_1:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey... Tin Can. If you're gonna explain, do it so people can understand.」

365:t_1:12.en:
$$モーム$$
「Simply put, it's a person or thing at the starting point of a $$時空震動$$.」

365:t_1:13.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Thanks, $$モーム$$. You're both robots, but you're a whole different build from the Tin Can.」

365:t_1:14.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$モーム$$'s good at cooking and laundry, too.」

365:t_1:15.en:
$$桂$$
「On top of that, she can do nursing and mech maintenance.」

365:t_1:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit is a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface. Such functions are not designated as part of its mission.」

365:t_1:18.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But $$モーム$$ helps $$桂$$ out in all kinds of ways, too.」

365:t_1:19.en:
$$パーラ$$
「That's right. She comforts him when he's down, and cheers him on when he's in a bind.」

365:t_1:20.en:
$$桂$$
「So she's perfect on the support side, too.」

365:t_1:21.en:
$$モーム$$
「Hearing you say that makes me so happy.」

365:t_1:23.en:
$$レド$$
「A complete defeat, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

365:t_1:25.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I think $$チェインバー#pilot$$ has good points of its own, too.」

365:t_1:26.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am grateful for your accurate observation, $$ティファ$$.」

365:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Well, compared to when he was found on $$翠の地球$$, this guy's gotten more human.」

365:t_1:28.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I disagree with that observation. This unit is strictly an interface and requires nothing such as humanity.」

365:t_1:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「...It happens when I watch $$レド$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

365:t_1:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「No need to worry. $$アル$$'s will lives on within me.」

365:t_1:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「...If I say something this spiritual, though, $$アル$$ would immediately demand an explanation.」

365:t_1:35.en:
$n
「But there's certainly something to that. $$誰か$$ living on in someone else's heart...」

365:t_1:36.en:
$$桂$$
「...In short, when the $$時空震動弾$$ that started this multiverse went off, $$オルソン$$ and I were on the spot, so we both became a $$特異点$$.」

365:t_1:37.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I hear a $$特異点$$ is an essential element for repairing spacetime.」

365:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「Then can you return the multiverse to its original state... back to each of its parallel worlds?」

365:t_1:40.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What do you mean by that? They say Colonel $$シャア$$, who became the $$特異点$$ of the $$新世時空震動$$, fixed the $$時の牢獄$$.」

365:t_1:41.en:
$$桂$$
「The case of $$蒼の地球$$ had a simple structure.」

365:t_1:42.en:
$$桂$$
「But the multiverse now, including worlds other than ours, has its phases tangled together too complexly, and they say repair is impossible.」

365:t_1:43.en:
$$桂$$
「If we could find the point where that complex knot converges, it might be doable, but...」

365:t_1:44.en:
$$桂$$
「In that case, the story goes, there's a risk that all the parallel worlds could be destroyed if we botch it.」

365:t_1:47.en:
$$エイミー$$
「No. Everyone in the fleet has gotten used to life on $$翠の地球$$, and $$レド$$ and I are making our way in this world, too.」

365:t_1:48.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Well... there are people like the $$サイデリアル$$ too, so it's not like everything is going well, but even so, I've come to love this world.」

365:t_1:49.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. Being told now that the world's going back to normal would just be a pain.」

365:t_1:50.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That might be the same as everyone accepting that time can't be turned back.」

365:t_1:51.en:
$$ティファ$$
「People overcome partings and regrets and move forward... I think the multiverse is the same.」

365:t_1:52.en:
$$桂$$
「Thanks, everyone. Hearing you say that eases my mind a little, as the one who set off the $$時空震動弾$$.」

365:t_1:54.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then what are the $$サイデリアル$$ guys holding this $$オルソン$$ guy for?」

365:t_1:55.en:
$$桂$$
「I helped with Dr. $$トライア$$'s experiments, too. He's probably become a subject of their hyper-spacetime physics research.」

365:t_1:56.en:
$$ガロード$$
「He might be used in something that extracts $$次元力$$.」

365:t_1:57.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Then we've got to go rescue him fast...!」

365:t_1:58.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't be so hasty. First we have to descend to $$翠の地球$$.」

365:t_1:59.en:
$$レド$$
「I heard the plan is for the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ to draw in the defense forces while a force centered on the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ descends all at once in the meantime.」

365:t_1:60.en:
$$桂$$
「And while the $$クォーター$$ plays decoy, the assault team rescues $$オルソン$$ from the base. That's the deal.」

365:t_1:62.en:
$$桂$$
「Never mind the $$特異点$$ business, I can't leave $$オルソン$$ to be the $$サイデリアル$$'s plaything.」

365:t_1:66.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

365:t_1:67.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Captain $$クルーゾー$$ and I will command the assault team.」

365:t_1:69.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s personnel dropped sharply. Even at a time like this, we revised the ranks to keep up appearances.」

365:t_1:70.en:
$$マオ$$
「So I got promoted to Ensign, too... a so-called commissioned officer, if you please.」

365:t_1:74.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You bet! Starting today, I'm a Master Sergeant, too.」

365:t_1:77.en:
$n
「Sorry. It's just, when I think of $$アルト$$ and $$レド$$ being Ensigns...」

365:t_1:78.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch... Compared to other organizations, $$ミスリル$$ really does give the people in the field low ranks...」

365:t_1:79.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Quit complaining, Master Sergeant. I expect work befitting your rank.」

365:t_1:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「For all his talk, he seems glad about the promotion.」

365:t_1:82.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't you envy your colleague's advancement, $$宗介$$?」

365:t_1:83.en:
$$宗介$$
「A Master Sergeant has to lead the team in the field. $$クルツ$$ is suited to that kind of work.」

365:t_1:84.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... it's a role that suits him, all right.」

365:t_1:85.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, $$クロウ$$... I flatly refuse to join the Short Straw Alliance.」
